tcgplayerEditionSkuFindings.skuSemantics: The current TCGPlayer source payload contains no SKU/version identifier beyond productID + printing + condition.
tcgplayerEditionSkuFindings.verifiedBasePayload: Base Charizard product 42382 reports printing=Holofoil and therefore has EXTERNAL_VARIANT_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE for edition-aware collection.
tcgplayerEditionSkuFindings.conditionSemantics: Condition remains condition_id and is never embedded in card_variant_id.
